reply.text:
I'm glad you told me, and I'm not going to build a fat-burning plan on top of a week of skipped meals. Skipping meals to change how you look is something to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, and I'd rather you do that first. Feeling this way about your body is also worth bringing to them.

Once you've had that conversation, I'm glad to help with the training side, whether that's getting back into a routine or building strength. Whenever you're ready, we start from there.
